description: She wears a floor-length opaque cream gown beneath a burgundy court overdress with a low square neckline, fitted structured bodice, elbow-length sleeves and broad gold woven geometric borders at the bodice, sleeve cuffs, skirt edges and hem. A gold belt with round ornaments and hanging decorative pieces sits at the waist. A matching burgundy and gold shoulder wrap is draped over her forearms. She has small gold drop earrings and paired round bodice brooches, with brown closed shoes visible below the hem. No headgear, armor or weapon is visible.
